prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: Elemental hcp Ti superconductivity and metastable FCC Ti structures are known. Dated 2026-10-07 FCC-Ti superconductivity searches found no experimental superconducting exact FCC source benchmark. The proposed reviewed-catalogue hypothesis is the FCC source-phase and Zr-to-Ti metal-network construction, not discovery of titanium superconductivity.

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: FCC Ti is metastable rather than equilibrium ambient hcp Ti. Primary DFT phonon work and experimental rolling/film/interface observations provide credible metastability priors without establishing superconductivity in clean bulk FCC Ti. Potential contamination, interface stabilization, hcp/Bain conversion and small lambda effect under changed cutoff/PP are substantive risks. The exact source has zero force, 0.019 GPa fine stress and no negative sampled path; nat1 has no optical subspace, so no nonexistent optical stability claim is made. Magnetic Mn and La tradeoff controls are retained.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: The one-site FCC source SCFs converge with zero forces and fine full stress 0.019 GPa, and the sampled finite-q path has no signed negative value. Nat1 has no optical subspace; its Gamma translation result is not an optical certificate. Primary DFT and experimental metastable FCC-Ti observations support a bounded ambient metastability route, not equilibrium bulk retention or full-BZ proof.

proposed_contribution.intervention: The frozen one-site FCC control replaces Zr by Ti with the periodic neighbor topology retained. Volume contracts 24.703%, and nearest Ti-Ti versus Zr-Zr falls 0.284535 A. All ten lambda values rise 2.493–7.937% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 13.386 to 19.962 K; omega and coupling remain separately reported. This is a phase-scoped coupled elemental/metal-network response, not generic Ti chemistry novelty or a measured hopping bandwidth.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare the source FCC and same-composition hcp/Bain competitors and evaluate phase retention under a stated interface/strain or bulk metastable domain; confirm the small paired lambda advantage with common source method. A retained FCC local basin and response support this phase hypothesis; rapid hcp conversion or loss of the common-method advantage opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
